text: dsh-mcp-orchestrator 是面向 DSH 的 MCP 服务器编排插件，使用 Cordis 工具接口接入。它读取配置并连接多个 stdio MCP 服务器，汇总各服务器提供的工具；用户或 agent 可以查询服务器状态和工具列表，并发起工具调用。工具重名时可按服务器命名空间整理，调用失败时还能按配置尝试其他提供同名工具的服务器。插件也能周期性检查连接状态，并提供调用次数、成功率和响应时间等统计。适合希望在 DSH 中统一使用多个 MCP 工具源的场景。需要在配置中提供要启动的 MCP 服务器命令及参数。

dsh-mcp-orchestrator connects stdio MCP servers to DSH and combines their tools. It lists server health and tools, routes calls, and can retry failures on another server providing the same tool. Statistics show status, success rates, and response times. Configure server commands and arguments.
想让 DSH 同时连接多个 stdio MCP 服务并统一使用它们的工具。
MCP 工具重名时，希望能看到区分服务器的名字，并在调用失败后尝试其他服务。
I want to check which MCP servers are connected and review tool call success rates from DSH.
dsh-mcp-orchestrator 的功能「聚合 MCP 工具」：连接已配置的多个 stdio 服务器并汇总可用工具。通过管理工具查看工具清单、名称冲突和所属服务器。
dsh-mcp-orchestrator 的功能「路由调用并查看运行情况」：通过 MCP 工具发起服务器工具调用，失败时可切换到其他同样提供该工具的服务器；还可查看服务器健康和调用统计。
dsh-mcp-orchestrator 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 85 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-mcp-orchestrator README · dsh-mcp-orchestrator：MCP orchestration layer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — multi-server management, health monitoring, auto-restart, tool aggregation with collision handling, fallback routing, and usage statistics.

dsh-mcp-orchestrator README · What It Does：DSH has built-in MCP client support, but it lacks orchestration: there's no health monitoring, no auto-restart on crash, no tool collision detection, no fallback routing, and no unified tool discovery. This plugin fills that gap.

dsh-mcp-orchestrator README · What It Does：**Key capabilities:**
- Connect to multiple stdio MCP servers simultaneously
- Health monitoring via periodic ping checks
- Auto-restart with exponential backoff on unexpected disconnection
- Tool aggregation across all servers with collision detection
- Three namespace modes for tool name conflicts (`collision`, `server`, `dot`)
- Fallback routing: when a tool call fails on one server, auto-retry on others providing the same tool
- Priority-weighted sorting: servers sorted by success rate then priority
- Usage statistics: per-server, per-tool, and overall call tracking with response times
- Four DSH management tools for the agent to discover, call, and monitor MCP tools

dsh-mcp-orchestrator README · Prerequisites：- Node.js >= 22.19 (or >= 24)
- DSH installed: `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`
- At least one MCP server to connect to

dsh-mcp-orchestrator README · Build：```bash
cd dsh-mcp-orchestrator
npm install
npm run build
```

dsh-mcp-orchestrator README · Install into DSH：**Option A: From GitHub (recommended)**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Daseanle/dsh-mcp-orchestrator
dsh web
```

**Option B: From local clone**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Daseanle/dsh-mcp-orchestrator.git
cd dsh-mcp-orchestrator && npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add file:./dsh-mcp-orchestrator
dsh web

dsh-mcp-orchestrator README · Config Schema (zod)：| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `servers` | array | `[]` | MCP server configurations |
| `servers[].name` | string | — | Unique server name |
| `servers[].command` | string | — | Executable to run |
| `servers[].args` | string[] | `[]` | Command line arguments |
| `servers[].env` | Record<string, string> | `{}` | Environment variables |
| `servers[].autoRestart` | boolean | `true` | Auto-restart on crash |
| `servers[].restartDelay` | number | `2000` | Base restart delay (ms) |
| `servers[].maxRestarts` | number | `3` | Max restart attempts |
| `servers[].priority` | number | `0` | Priority for tool resolution (higher = preferred) |
| `healthCheckInterval` | number | `30000` | Ping interval (ms) |
| `namespaceMode` | enum | `collision` | Tool name collision handling |
| `enableFallback` | boolean | `true` | Enable fallback routing on tool call failure |
| `maxFallbackAttempts` | number | `3` | Max servers to try before giving up |
| `preferHealthyServers` | boolean | `true` | Sort candidates by success rate (false = priority only) |
| `enableStats` | boolean | `true` | Register mcp

dsh-mcp-orchestrator README · Namespace Modes：| Mode | Behavior | Example |
|------|----------|---------|
| `collision` | Namespace only when same tool name exists on 2+ servers | `echo` → `server1__echo` (if collision) |
| `server` | Always namespace with `serverName__toolName` | `echo` → `server1__echo` |
| `dot` | Always namespace with `serverName.toolName` | `echo` → `server1.echo` |
